requirements: R1: Synchronize Moodle role hierarchy into the archive role model.
R2: Implement automatic access control for closed strains and analytical reports based on Moodle departments and courses.
R3: Fix the HTTP 401 errors blocking the EmployeeDossierController endpoints.
R4: Incorporate mandatory keywords auth and validation in acceptance criteria to define security boundaries.
R5: Acknowledge and properly handle POL_CHERCHLAND_17_RAG_GROUNDING_CAPSULE as an existing pattern.

slices.title: Resolve SSO Role Sync, 401s, and Audit Mentions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the defect fixes for this epic, I want to patch role synchronization, enforce department access control, fix 401 errors on dossiers, and ensure auth/validation and POL_CHERCHLAND_17_RAG_GROUNDING_CAPSULE are respected, so that the self-falsification findings are fully resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an SSO login event, When Moodle auth succeeds, Then the Moodle role hierarchy synchronizes to the archive role model and mandatory validation occurs.
Given an EmployeeDossierController request, When an authenticated user accesses the endpoint, Then it returns HTTP 200/201 instead of 401.
Given a request for closed strains or reports, When accessed, Then automatic access control restricts them by Moodle department and course.
Given the task constraints, When evaluated, Then the valid pattern POL_CHERCHLAND_17_RAG_GROUNDING_CAPSULE is actively utilized and recognized.
